'''Korden Outfitting and Surveying''' was a business established by the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Haddius Korden]] in about [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], which specialized in supplying equipment to colonists. The [[House Korden|Korden family]] eventually started making direct investments into new colonies and as a result, it was commonplace for Korden Outfitting and Surveying retail outlets to be established at newly-settled ports. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Tavin Korden]] served as the leader of Korden Outfitting and Surveying.
